milestones.title: Foundations: tokens, themes, contrast
milestones.description: The colour, type and spacing system, the theming model, and the contrast audit that guards them.

milestones.title: Direction and internationalisation
milestones.description: Right-to-left correctness, bidi isolation, locale resolution and everything that follows from a writing direction.

milestones.title: Form controls
milestones.description: Everything a form needs after the input, checkbox and button: selects, radios, switches, sliders, dates, files and the error summary.

milestones.title: Overlays and disclosure
milestones.description: Tooltips, popovers, menus, drawers and the command palette: the surfaces where focus management decides whether a product is usable.

milestones.title: Navigation and structure
milestones.description: Links, accordions, breadcrumbs, pagination, steppers and trees: the components that tell a user where they are.

milestones.title: Feedback and status
milestones.description: Alerts, toasts, progress, spinners and empty states — including the live regions that make them audible.

milestones.title: Data and display
milestones.description: Tables, cards, badges and avatars: reading surfaces, where structure matters more than decoration.

milestones.title: Gallery and Actix surface
milestones.description: The documentation site itself: routes, assets, headers, error pages and the server behaviour behind them.

milestones.title: Test harnesses and CI
milestones.description: The machinery that keeps the guarantees honest: markup assertions, axe, keyboard runs, no-JavaScript runs, coverage floors.

milestones.title: Documentation and decisions
milestones.description: Guides, recipes, ADRs and the migration story for teams arriving from a React component library.

milestones.title: Packaging and release
milestones.description: Crate metadata, MSRV policy, semver, changelogs, docs.rs and the supply-chain checks before a publish.

milestones.title: Performance budgets
milestones.description: Payload size, render cost and compression: what the library is allowed to cost a page.

milestones.title: Security
milestones.description: Escaping, CSP compatibility, form security and dependency auditing.

milestones.title: WCAG 2.2 conformance dossier
milestones.description: One entry per A and AA success criterion: what it means here, how it is checked, and what a reviewer must confirm by hand.

milestones.title: Framework integrations
milestones.description: Making the components usable from the server frameworks people actually run, rather than from Actix alone.

issues.title: Link: design the Rust API
issues.body:
## Link: design the Rust API

- Element: `<a href>`
- Role: link, implicit
- Why this component exists: Applications need a link that is a link — not a button pretending to navigate.

### Acceptance criteria

- A builder in `crates/ui-storm/src/components/link.rs` with `new(..)` taking every prop that has no safe default.
- Enums for variants and states, each with the `as_str()`/`class()` helpers used by `button.rs`.
- Borrowed `&'a str` props rather than `String`, so rendering does not allocate for static text.
- Rustdoc with a `# Examples` block that is compiled as a doctest.
- Re-exported from `crates/ui-storm/src/lib.rs` and listed in `components/mod.rs`.

### Definition of done

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- --deny warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass.
- The gallery page for this component shows the behaviour described above.
- No new TODO, no commented-out code, no `unwrap` in library code.

_Part of the Rust/Actix rewrite; see `docs/adr/0002-rust-rewrite.md`._

- Names: The legend names the group; each radio's label is its name; a group-level error is described on the fieldset.
- Every id the component writes is unique and prefixed by the component id, so two instances never collide.
- No `aria-label` duplicating visible text; no role invented where an element exists.

- The gallery renders in this locale and every component survives it.

- A Playwright snapshot pins the result so a later font change is visible in review.

### Definition of done
